reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by 21st.dev (https://21st.dev/).
Technology stack: react, tailwind, shadcn-ui.
Component specification: Community Themes 画廊证明资源可直接服务 shadcn 主题配置。
Key visual & interaction patterns: 提示词输入框、流式文本、模型选择器.
Visual details from source observation: 我们进去先看首页那排会动的营销区块，Liquid Metal、Hero ASCII 一块块铺开。真正让我们停下来的是组件目录：点进 v0 AI Chat 能看到预览、源码和这条作者标的 MIT，Themes 页还能把 Vercel 配色连 CSS 拷走。适合在 shadcn 栈里东拼西凑的人；Newest 里夹着名叫 Test 的条目，质量随作者浮动。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
